purpose: fine-tune the released GENCO checkpoint as in finetune.ipynb, with replay of released N-2 scenarios in every optimizer step, and evaluate it later (evaluate_finetuned) against the released model on cases neither has seen

differences_from_finetune.replay: one micro-batch of 4 released N-2 scenarios at the actual load per optimizer step, targets their stored AC solutions; pool: the base points of blocks [2, 3, 4, 5] and every scenario of blocks [8, 9, 10, 11]; held out for selection: the validation base points and 10% of the replay blocks
differences_from_finetune.replay_weight: step loss = training micro-batches (as in finetune.ipynb) + w x replay micro-batch, with w = (mean released-model loss on the pilot training cases) / (mean released-model loss on as many replay cases), capped at 100.0
differences_from_finetune.selection: lowest validation loss among checkpoints whose median worst-bus Vm error on the held-out replay scenarios is at most (1 + 0.1) x the released model's; the released model qualifies
differences_from_finetune.budget: TRAIN_BUDGET_MIN = 95 (70 in finetune.ipynb), so that the same MAX_EPOCHS fit

objective: the released training objective, unchanged: graphkit MixedLoss of caseTexas_train.yaml = 0.9 x masked bus MSE (Vm, Va) + 0.1 x layered weighted physics residual (base weight 0.5), in the released normalisation

data.excluded_why: 0-1: base points of K1/N1/N2 (the storms of T2's near-fold test); 6, 16: the final evaluation F1 (T2's main test); 7: T2's forgetting check on released N-2 scenarios
data.labels: Newton-Raphson (lightsim2grid KLU) to 1e-8 p.u. from the pre-contingency, DC and flat starts with the branch check on; a case is a regression target only if verified, with one solution among the starts and a lowest voltage >= LOW_V_EXCLUDE; unresolved cases are kept as labels for the solvability head (notebook T2)
data.split: by base point: 10% of the training base points (seeded) are validation, never trained on

selection: the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss (the training objective on the validation split), evaluated every 100 optimizer steps and at the end of each epoch, among those that keep ordinary accuracy (see differences_from_finetune)
sizing: EPOCHS = min(4, max(1, floor(95 min / (pilot seconds per case x (training cases + replay cases per epoch))))); the pilot's weight updates are discarded
evaluation: notebook T2, frozen before this run: paired released vs fine-tuned on the 870 F1 cases (GENCO-alone misses against the verified reference, worst-bus voltage error, Newton iterations, verdicts), on soft-footprint N-20 cases built on the F1 base points (a construction held out of training), on released N-2 (block 7), N-10 and N-20 scenarios (forgetting), on the 120 K1 storms against their stored AC truth along the load sweep (near-fold response), and the solvability head
